temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia seems more withdrawn than usual; when asked, she says it is personal stuff and thanks him but does not elaborate.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is usually vibrant, and Jose has no specific reason to think she is struggling.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - her withdrawn behavior and vague answer lead him to suspect she is dealing with something personal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia may be troubled by a personal issue and could need a supportive listener without pressure.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Be available as a nonjudgmental listener and offer support if she wants to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During lunch, Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments; she later confirms she is overwhelmed by bills and is open to discussing financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia may be dealing with an unspecified personal issue, but Jose does not know it is financial.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - he learns that finances are a concrete source of stress and that she may welcome help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is stressed by bills and financial commitments, and she is receptive to budgeting or financial-planning support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Deepened concern, empathy, and cautious helpfulness.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer to go over budgeting or financial-planning tips together when she feels up to it.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia reassures Jose that she did not mind his financial-planning offer and says she is grateful rather than thinking he was prying.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose worries that bringing up Patricia's finances may have overstepped her boundaries or invaded her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Patricia's reassurance resolves his worry and confirms that his support is welcome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia welcomes his help as friendly support, not prying; he can support her while still respecting her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting Patricia as a friend while being respectful of her boundaries and avoiding prying.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says everything is all good and she plans a quiet weekend at home; she thanks Jose and says she will keep his offer in mind.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his support and does not see him as overstepping; Jose is considering how much to keep offering help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - he refines his belief: she appreciates concern but seems to prefer handling her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia values his friendship and support, but she likely wants privacy and low-pressure contact rather than active problem-solving.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Respectful concern, empathy, and mild acceptance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Stay available and check in casually without pushing for details or offering intrusive help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose checks in and offers help, even just coffee; Patricia says she is busy but handling it, thanks him, and says his support is great.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his concern but prefers privacy, so Jose should maintain a supportive presence without overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change - the exchange confirms that Patricia is managing and values his nonintrusive support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is coping with her situation and appreciates friendly, supportive check-ins at work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue regular friendly check-ins and offer help without pressuring her or prying into her private matters.
